subject: Invoice intake channel constraints and onboarding form implications
messages:
From: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@lumahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@lumahealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: preferred invoice channel + sample rows

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. We're pulling together everything your team needs to activate LumaHealth as a supplier. Two quick questions we hit while filling your onboarding form: 

1) Invoice channel: our finance team prefers sending batch invoices via SFTP (nightly), but our accounts payable can also email PDF invoices to an SMTP fallback. Do you require portal-first (manual upload), or do you support a hybrid (SFTP primary + SMTP fallback) without losing PO linking?

2) Template: we attached a CSV with our current export. The line-item schema includes a freeform description column and a tax breakdown per line. Will your ingest pipeline accept variable line descriptions, or do you need fixed field mapping (unit_price, qty, tax_code)?

I've attached the onboarding form we completed and a small sample invoice extract. If it helps, we can pilot two invoices next week.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (pdf), sample_invoice_template_v2.csv (csv)

Appreciate any constraints or non-negotiables so we can adjust.

Best,
Rachel
Vendor Ops — LumaHealth
---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: preferred invoice channel + sample rows

Hi Rachel — thanks for the attachments and the clear questions. Short answers up front, then details + next steps.

Short answers:
- We support portal-first for best PO-linking and acknowledgement. Hybrid (SFTP primary + SMTP fallback) is supported, but invoices submitted by SMTP must include a subject token or PO number in the filename to guarantee automated matching.
- Variable freeform descriptions are okay, but for reliable line-level matching we recommend the CSV include columns: external_line_id, po_number, sku (optional), qty, unit_price, tax_amount, line_description.

Details and constraints:
- Portal: when you upload via the vendor portal we generate an immediate ACK and an automatic PO-match attempt (best accuracy). This path gives fastest processing and fewer manual exceptions.
- SFTP: nightly batch is fine; please use the sample envelope format in the attached sample CSV. Envelopes must be UTF-8 encoded and use ISO date for invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- SMTP: accepted as backstop but only processed during business hours; large batches by SMTP will be queued and may be matched only the next business day. If you use SMTP, include the subject token (we provided one in your onboarding form) or include PO numbers in the filename.

Monica and Markus: looping you in for confirmation on the tolerance for freeform description and to confirm whether we can accept a combined tax column vs per-line tax. Monica: what's our current policy on accepting per-invoice tax_total vs per-line tax_amount?

Next steps:
- Rachel: can you send two pilot invoices via SFTP next Tuesday (nightly drop) using the attached sample envelope? We'll process and share exception logs.
- We'll also accept the same two invoices via SMTP to confirm fallback handling, but please alter filenames to include the PO number so we can test matching.

Thanks — Vanessa
Director, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: preferred invoice channel + sample rows

Thanks for the ping. Quick policy notes: 

- We prefer per-line tax_amount if available. If vendors can't provide line-level taxes we accept tax_total at invoice level, but that increases the chance of PO-match exceptions for multi-tax-line POs.
- Freeform descriptions are acceptable for human-readable fields, but automated reconciliation relies on either external_line_id or SKU. If neither exists, we'll fall back to description-based fuzzy match (higher false-positive risk).
- Encoding: SFTP files must include a BOM-free UTF-8 header. Non-UTF encodings will be rejected by our parser.

Markus: for this pilot, we'll allow per-invoice tax_total but flag any exceptions; if LumaHealth's sample results in >5% exception rate we should require per-line taxes for future invoices.

Monica
Vendor Payments Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@lumahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@lumahealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: preferred invoice channel + sample rows

Hi Vanessa / Monica — thanks for the clarity and the policy notes. We'll run the pilot as requested. A few clarifying items before the drop:

1) Filename convention for SMTP fallback: is PO_<po_number>_INV_<invoice_number>.pdf acceptable?
2) For SFTP envelope: can you confirm the folder structure (we will send to sftp.redwood.com/inbound/lumahealth/YYYYMMDD/)?
3) If we include tax_total only, will you provide a structured exception report for rejected line matches? We want to measure exception types so we can adapt our ERP export.

We'll send the sample SFTP nightly on Tue 2027-06-29 (our timezone PST). I'll include two sample invoices and keep the Subject token in the SMTP versions.

Thanks again — looking forward to the pilot results.

Rachel
Vendor Ops — LumaHealth
